pairs.difference: A: ball has a few broad soft sheens on the red and blue panels and a clean, dark-edged contact shadow on the right. B: ball has a smooth pale form turn that goes violet on the white panels, a big dark shadow to the lower left, and a noisy photographic sand grain.
pairs.fix: Model the ball with one broad soft sheen and a gentle form turn. Keep the cast shadow a soft, light-toned contact shadow. Make the sand clean and painted.

pairs.difference: A: target face is a flat, soft blue disc, with an even glow from the bulbs and a plush bear with a soft gradient. B: target is tilted and its white rim is lit unevenly. The bulbs are small hot points, the shelf front falls into a dark red void, and the bear's face is glossy.
pairs.fix: Light the target face evenly with a gentle turn. Give the bulbs a soft glow. Keep the shelf front mid-value rather than near black.

pairs.difference: A: crisp diagonal window-light streaks on the wall, and the unit has a clean white form with a thin edge sheen. B: a yellow bloom on the left wall, a lilac-tinted body with a bright rim sheen on the top left, and a soft dark shadow right of the unit.
pairs.fix: Keep the wall light clean and neutral, with no glow haze. Make the unit's sheen a narrow, soft highlight with a gentle edge shadow.

pairs.difference: A: chest has a strongly lit gold lid rim, a deep interior shadow, and bubbles with sharp highlights. B: smooth airbrushed gradients on the gold, sparkly gems and a long soft shadow on the sand to the right.
pairs.fix: Give the gold a few broad highlights instead of airbrushed gradients. Keep gems with simple facet highlights and a tighter contact shadow.

pairs.difference: A: cap has gentle even light, a soft cast shadow on the floor and a pale white crown with a mild turn. B: a hard diagonal light patch and shadow on the back wall, a deep dark form shadow under the brim, and a dramatic orange glow on the floor.
pairs.fix: Use soft, even key light. Remove the hard wall light patch and keep the brim shadow a gentle, mid-value contact shadow.

pairs.difference: A: booth has a crisp, dark cast shadow on the floor to the left, a clear light-to-shadow turn across the red faces and a bright door-handle highlight. B: red is saturated and flat, with a bright vertical edge glow on the left, a murky interior and a faint soft base shadow.
pairs.fix: Add a clear cast shadow and a visible light side and shadow side on the red faces. Make the glass interior clean, not murky.

pairs.difference: A: gloves have bright, tidy glossy hot spots and crisp creases, with a soft shadow on the wood. B: lumpy forms with smooth soft shading, deep dark crease pockets, and a flat-lit table.
pairs.fix: Give the gloves a defined broad highlight on each knuckle. Keep creases shallow, with a soft contact shadow under them.

pairs.difference: A: fins have glossy sharp white sheen strips along the yellow edges, a high-contrast dark cuff and bluish rim light on the right fin. B: soft, even orange with gentle broad shading and no hot spots.
pairs.fix: Replace the sharp white sheen strips with one broad soft highlight. Remove the cool rim light and keep the form turn gentle.

pairs.difference: A: clean flat-lit pier with small highlights on the wood and a soft ring where the posts meet the water. B: large saturated gradients, a dark shaded post side, glowing cyan ripple rings, and a lifebuoy with strong sheen and a dramatic cast shadow in the water.
pairs.fix: Flatten the water glow, use a gentle form shadow on the posts, and keep the lifebuoy sheen small and soft.

pairs.difference: A: palm has a clear leaf-shaped cast shadow on the sand and a ribbed trunk with simple banded shading. B: leaves have smooth airbrushed gradients with a bright midrib and a dark underside, a soft glow on the trunk and rocks, and a weak cast shadow.
pairs.fix: Shade the leaves with a simple light side and shadow side. Add a defined cast shadow on the sand under the leaves.

pairs.difference: A: locker has a soft glossy sheen on its rounded edges, a cast shadow on the wall and a clear light-to-shadow turn on the side. B: front-lit, with flat, evenly lit orange panels, a soft floor shadow and almost no visible shadow side.
pairs.fix: Add a visible shadow side on the locker and a cast shadow on the wall. Keep the sheen on the edges soft.

pairs.difference: A: slide has bright glossy green, a clear splash with a highlight, and clean cast shadows on the tiles. B: the slide has a smooth, dark shadow side, a broad sheen on the top curve and a weak cast shadow on the tiles.
pairs.fix: Keep the slide bright and glossy on its shadow side, and add a clear cast shadow on the tiles.

pairs.difference: A: player has crisp bright edge highlights, a defined button ring and a mild turn on the orange body. B: smooth glossy body with a broad soft top sheen, a large dark lower shadow, and a blurry earbud and cable shading.
pairs.fix: Make the body's shading simple, with crisp small edge highlights and a lighter shadow side.

pairs.difference: A: envelope has a flat cream surface with a mild turn, and a dark underlay shadow beneath. B: envelope has a smooth soft cream sheen, a bright rim along the lower edge and a rounded stamp with a soft glow.
pairs.fix: Keep the envelope's cream a flat tone with a mild turn. Keep the edge light narrow and add a clean contact shadow.

pairs.difference: A: fruit has small bright hot spots on the grapes and berries, with a soft shadow under the plate. B: similar hot spots, with a slightly broader soft shadow on the tilted plate. Both read in the same range on this vector.

A: strong ivy cast shadows across the door and a deep shadow in the panel recesses, with a lit side and a shadow side. B: arched door is almost evenly lit, with little bias, only small soft panel shadows and nothing cast on the door.
pairs.fix: Soften the ivy shadows on the door. Keep them lighter in value and make the panel recesses shallow.

pattern: The generated cards lean toward dramatic or atmospheric lighting. This shows as hard diagonal light patches, deep dark shadow pockets, airbrushed gradients with broad glowing sheens, and sharp white hot spots or rim light. The real cards use gentler, simpler shading: a small soft highlight, a mild form turn, and a tidy contact shadow. My calls on pairs p01 to p04 and p09 to p14 are guesses, and most of them are low-confidence.
